This page will organize the guided coding projects that accompany the lectures.

## Project format

Each coding project will include:

1. Learning objectives and conceptual background
2. Environment and dataset setup
3. A detailed implementation walkthrough
4. Experiments and interpretation
5. Exercises and extension challenges
6. Reproducibility and submission requirements

:::{.callout-note}
Projects will be added incrementally as we finalize the lecture sequence.
:::
